positions.title: Research Scientist 2
positions.description:
•	Developed the JISAO Seasonal Coastal Ocean Prediction of the Ecosystem for the Pacific Northwest waters, and evaluated performance of the prediction models.
•	Created forecast ensembles of ocean conditions that are used for prediction of sardine distribution,  management decisions for fisheries, protected species and ecosystem. Created numerical datasets in 4D and developed machine learning models to provide better understanding and forecastings on different temporal and spatial scales in the Pacific Northwest 
• Produced quarterly forecast reports.

•	Focused on characterizing upwelling/downwelling processes for pollutant spreading by analyzing a 54-year simulation dataset.

projects.title: JISAO Seasonal Coastal Ocean Prediction of the Ecosystem
projects.description:
•	Performed and evaluated the Regional Ocean Model System (ROMS) ensembles to forecast seasonal variability of ocean conditions and development of hypoxia for Pacific Northwest waters.
•	Determined seasonal anomaly of important surface and bottom ocean fields, using Matlab.
•	Analyzed observations of temperature, oxygen, total inorganic concentration and alkalinity to validate and select the predictive model of ecosystem health –related fields (pH and aragonite). 
•	Identified main predictors that result in significant biases of the ROMS forecasts; set up experimental runs in order to quantify and reduce these biases.
